notes: The head «حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش» is written once and repeated in both groups, because the second route («وعن قيس بن مسلم») starts from the same Al-A'mash
The second route carries the same saying, so it is a group, not a variant (rule 4)
«أبيه» is written without a name: a bare relation
«أبي سعيد» stands twice in the chain; the occurrence marks each route's own Companion

fixes.reason: HKG's route names «رجاء بن ربيعة» as the next link after إسماعيل بن رجاء; the text writes only «أبيه», a bare relation with no name.
